description: Queue English presentation narration as a page-timed MP4, M4B, or MP3. English-only launch: PDF files up to 10 MiB, selected narration up to 20 pages, 18,000 characters, or 20 generated minutes, and one active audio job per account. MP3/M4B cost 15 credits per generated minute; MP4 costs 20 credits per generated minute. Poll the returned server execution ID; it is not an HTTP retry idempotency key.
